note: Short-read assembly and annotation of a bacterial isolate. Optional: GenomeSize per sample in the samplesheet.
Long-read assembly and annotation of a bacterial isolate.

Taxonomic profiling. databases: a CSV naming your profiler databases (taxprofiler docs). For assembly and binning instead: nf-core/mag 5.5.0. Element is not in taxprofiler's platform list, so Element metagenomes get no recommendation here.
Marker-gene amplicons (16S, ITS). 3.0.0 is newer but under two weeks old on 2026-10-22, so 2.18.0 is pinned (CLAUDE.md D30).
SARS-CoV-2 amplicon analysis (variants, consensus). primer_set and primer_set_version: your scheme, e.g. artic and a version number.
RNA-seq of one organism. Strandedness is written as auto (inferred by rnaseq).

Human genome (target_taxid 9606): mapping, preprocessing and variant calling. genome is written as GATK.GRCh38, sarek's own default: change it if you need another build. tools: the variant callers to run (e.g. haplotypecaller for germline SNVs and indels). patient is set to the sample ID; add sex and status (0 normal, 1 tumour) if you know them.
